name: Band Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand with a band pinned under your front foot, ends held at shoulder height, and rear foot resting on a bench.
Stand tall with your chest lifted and core braced.
Bend your front knee smoothly to lower your back knee toward the floor until your front thigh approaches parallel.
Drive firmly through your front foot to stand upright against the band, then switch legs after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your front heel planted flat and your knee tracking straight over your toes.
Keep your torso mostly upright rather than leaning heavily back onto the bench.
